findings.message: https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/ce-59e8d15f-7895-4346-a5a8-7a0739a3d344 asserts ceterms:hasPart https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/ce-d9a8ddae-ea6e-4f69-9c36-3f51a3104a0e, but https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/ce-d9a8ddae-ea6e-4f69-9c36-3f51a3104a0e asserts ceterms:isPartOf without pointing back at https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/ce-59e8d15f-7895-4346-a5a8-7a0739a3d344. Both directions are present and they disagree.

rule.citation: ceterms:hasPart declares owl:inverseOf ceterms:isPartOf in the schema encoding: if A ceterms:hasPart B is asserted, then B ceterms:isPartOf A must hold wherever both directions are stated.

findings.message: https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/ce-d9a8ddae-ea6e-4f69-9c36-3f51a3104a0e asserts ceterms:isPartOf but https://credentialengineregistry.org/resources/ce-59e8d15f-7895-4346-a5a8-7a0739a3d344 does not assert the declared inverse ceterms:hasPart. One direction alone is not an error.

rule.citation: ceterms:isPartOf declares owl:inverseOf ceterms:hasPart in the schema encoding: if A ceterms:isPartOf B is asserted, then B ceterms:hasPart A must hold wherever both directions are stated.
